summary: SAML on upgrade: 2.6 authenticators don't support encrypted private keys, so replace encrypted SP keys with unencrypted ones before upgrading from 2.4 or the SAML authenticator isn't migrated and must be recreated by a local admin; shows SOCIAL_AUTH_SAML_ENABLED_IDPS and SP settings mapped to the gateway IDP_URL, IDP_X509_CERT, IDP_ENTITY_ID and SP_* configuration.
questions: Why was my SAML authenticator not migrated to AAP 2.6?
Does AAP 2.6 support encrypted SAML private keys?
How do 2.4 SAML settings map to the platform gateway?

answer_card.title: Replace encrypted SAML keys before upgrading
answer_card.answer_md: AAP 2.6 authenticators don't support encrypted private keys. Before upgrading from 2.4, replace any encrypted `SOCIAL_AUTH_SAML_SP_PRIVATE_KEY` with an unencrypted key. Otherwise the SAML authenticator isn't migrated to the platform gateway, and a local administrator has to recreate it before SSO users can log in again.
